indication: Quizartinib in combination with standard IDArubicin and cytarabine induction chemotherapy for adult patients with newly diagnosed acute myeloid leukaemia (AML) who are FLT3-ITD mutation positive.
description: The Republic of Ireland's Health Service Executive (HSE) has approved quizartinib in combination with standard idarubicin and cytarabine induction chemotherapy as a treatment option for the treatment of adult patients with newly diagnose acute myeloid leukaemia (AML) who are FLT3-ITD mutation positive.
